definitions.explanation: Refers to something written or listed further down in a document or text. A formal written expression used in business correspondence, official documents, and instructions.

examples.japanese: {下記|かき}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧ご⟦{参照|さんしょう}→参照：11866_sanshou⟧⟦ください→下さい：02899_kudasai⟧。
{下記|かき}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{日程|にってい}→日程：04289_nittei⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧ご⟦{都合|つごう}→都合：01672_tsugou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦いかが→いかが：02846_ikaga⟧です⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧。
examples.english: Would the following dates work for you?

examples.japanese: お⟦{申|もう}し{込|こ}み→申し込み：03161_moushikomi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{下記|かき}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{連絡先|れんらくさき}→連絡先：03191_renrakusaki⟧⟦まで→まで：00490_made⟧⟦お{願|ねが}いいたします→お願いいたします：27603_onegaiitashimasu⟧。
examples.english: Please direct your applications to the contact information below.

notes:
USAGE: {下記|かき} is a formal written expression. Like ⟦{上記|じょうき}→上記：11375_jouki⟧, it is almost exclusively used in writing. In speech, people say ⟦{下|した}→下：00670_shita⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{書|か}いてある→書く：00477_kaku⟧ or ⟦{以下|いか}→以下：01294_ika⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧ instead.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {下記|かき}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{通|とお}り→通り：01475_toori⟧ (as follows)
- {下記|かき}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{住所|じゅうしょ}→住所：01430_juusho⟧ (the address below)
- {下記|かき}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{連絡先|れんらくさき}→連絡先：03191_renrakusaki⟧ (the contact information below)
- {下記|かき}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦ご{覧|らん}→ご覧：01408_goran⟧⟦ください→下さい：02899_kudasai⟧ (please see below)

PAIR: The opposite is ⟦{上記|じょうき}→上記：11375_jouki⟧ (above-mentioned).
